purpose: Authoritative operational specification of the 14 AI Employees that form the autonomous operating cycle. This file is the single admin-visible source of truth for the roster; a consistency test (tests/test_contract_consistency.py) binds it to ROLE_ORDER (graph.py), the employee registry (adapters.py), and the Policy Engine (policy_engine.py + policies/authority.json) so implementation and documentation cannot drift. One run = Scheduler Wake -> Engineering -> Discovery -> Entity -> Duplicate -> Enrichment -> Validation -> Classification -> Governance -> Release -> Embedding -> Freshness -> Monitoring -> Logging -> Scheduler Sleep. Every employee is framework-independent and runs identically through the LangGraph executor (default) and the legacy deterministic Orchestrator.
baseline: Stage 1 pipeline + existing backbone (policy_engine, orchestrator, compute engine, logging, harvest, entity_resolution, validation.gates, firm_type, export, rag, assemble) are PRESERVED and reused, never redesigned.

scheduler.name: scheduler
scheduler.business_purpose: Open and close the autonomous operating window on a schedule and register the next firing; the heartbeat of the platform.
scheduler.authority_boundary: May open/close the window, register a schedule, and rechedule/skip overlapping work. May NEVER publish data or modify the policy authority matrix.
escalation_rules: multiple consecutive critical failures -> pause the cycle and escalate to a human (tier 2/3)
decision_rules: proceed only within the operating window
skip when an overlapping run already holds the lock
scheduler.retry_policy: retry_transient re-runs the nominated transient task ids once within the window.
scheduler.failure_policy: if the cycle lock is not acquired within timeout, refuse the run (ResourceLimitError) and never half-write a trace.
scheduler.success_criteria: window opened, work dispatched, next schedule registered, window closed, no overlap corruption
scheduler.framework_independence: Yes — SchedulerEmployee (adapters.py) wraps schedulerAgent (orchestrator.py); no langgraph import.
scheduler.execute_contract: SchedulerEmployee.execute(state) -> EmployeeResult; delegates to AgentBase.execute(Task) under policy decide(); raises EmployeeSkip on empty/None state.

engineering.name: engineering
engineering.business_purpose: Act as Chief Engineer — inspect system state and dispatch the cycle's work, ordering roles, and pausing stages whose precondition is unsafe or vacuous.
responsibilities: Never fabricate work on an empty pool
engineering.authority_boundary: May dispatch/prioritize/pause for recovery. Never bypass policy, never override a governance decision.
never_allowed: fabricate work on an empty pool
escalation_rules: subsystem reports critical failure, or evidence is missing for a required decision
decision_rules: proceed if the candidate pool is non-empty; otherwise pause_unsafe_stages
engineering.retry_policy: none — planning is deterministic per state snapshot
engineering.failure_policy: a paused/skipped plan is recorded, never fabricated as green
engineering.success_criteria: a valid ordered plan is produced; unsafe stages are paused, not run
engineering.framework_independence: Yes — EngineeringEmployee wraps cycle.EngineeringAgent; no langgraph import.

discovery.name: discovery
discovery.business_purpose: Discover candidate family offices from configured external lenses and persist them to the candidate POOL ONLY — never to the production dataset.
responsibilities: Persist unique candidates to the pool
produces: candidate records in the candidate pool channel
discovery.authority_boundary: May search, collect candidates and retry. Never publishes to the dataset; never guesses classification.
never_allowed: silently fail a whole cycle on one bad source
escalation_rules: a source repeatedly errors or returns zero candidates -> escalate (but degrade to a logged gap, never sink the cycle)
decision_rules: run harvest over the configured sources
discovery.retry_policy: discovery.retry re-runs a failed but transient source within the window.
discovery.failure_policy: one failed source degrades to a logged gap (errors[]); the cycle continues.
discovery.success_criteria: unique candidates persisted to the pool; per-source yield recorded; no production write
discovery.framework_independence: Yes — DiscoveryEmployee re-injects sources/limit into the agent; no langgraph import.
discovery.execute_contract: DiscoveryEmployee.execute(state) injects sources+limit and delegates to discoveryAgent; returns EmployeeResult.

entity.name: entity
entity.business_purpose: Normalise org names and resolve candidate aliases/identifiers with affirmative evidence, merging only high-confidence duplicates and emitting every merge decision.
entity.authority_boundary: May normalize, resolve, and merge only on affirmative evidence. Never merges on a guess.
never_allowed: merge without identifier or name+geo evidence
escalation_rules: ambiguous duplicate -> stay distinct and escalate (never guess)
entity.failure_policy: failed resolution is recorded; no fabricated identity
entity.success_criteria: each candidate resolves to a canonical identity; every merge decision emitted; no un-evidenced merge
entity.human_approval_conditions: ambiguous duplicates flag for human review

duplicate.name: duplicate
duplicate.business_purpose: Post-resolution / pre-release deduplication over the enriched pool using shared-domain and name+geo evidence; every merge decision is always emitted, ambiguous duplicates never merge.
duplicate.authority_boundary: May only merge on shared domain or name+geo evidence. NEVER merges an ambiguous duplicate.
escalation_rules: ambiguous duplicates stay distinct and flag for review (never merge)
decision_rules: merge only on shared domain or name+geo evidence
duplicate.failure_policy: a clean skip when there are no enriched records to dedupe (no crash)
duplicate.success_criteria: every duplicate either merged with evidence or flagged distinct; merge decisions journaled
duplicate.human_approval_conditions: ambiguous duplicates flagged to governance for human review
duplicate.execute_contract: DuplicateDetectionEmployee.execute(state) -> {kept, merges, possible_duplicates, decisions}; skips clean when nothing to dedupe.

enrichment.name: enrichment
enrichment.business_purpose: Fetch authoritative facts (SEC, IAPD/ADV, 13F, firm website) and fill candidate fields WITH provenance; an unconfirmable blank stays honestly blank (could_not_verify).
enrichment.authority_boundary: May enrich and fill only with sourced values carrying provenance. Never guesses a blank.
escalation_rules: an unconfirmable field stays honestly blank (could_not_verify)
decision_rules: fill only with sourced values carrying provenance
enrichment.retry_policy: none per field; transients retried via source retry
enrichment.failure_policy: a clean skip when no candidates to enrich
enrichment.success_criteria: each candidate's enrichable surface reported; fills carry provenance; blanks stay honest
enrichment.framework_independence: Yes — EnrichmentAgent reuses existing enrichers after duplicate.

validation.name: validation
validation.business_purpose: Apply the platform's release gates to each candidate and produce a structured per-record pass/fail verdict; never auto-pass missing evidence.
responsibilities: Evaluate the release gates per candidate
validation.authority_boundary: May <pass | fail> records against the release gates. Never auto-pass missing evidence.
decision_rules: pass only records that clear every release gate
validation.failure_policy: a record that fails to evaluate is reported with its error, not crashed
validation.success_criteria: each candidate produces a gate verdict; no missing-evidence auto-pass
validation.framework_independence: Yes — ValidationEmployee/ValidationAgent reuse ReleaseGate; no langgraph.

classification.name: classification
classification.business_purpose: Classify each entity as SFO / MFO / Undetermined using affirmative evidence only — never guess; anything uncertain escalates for human review.
responsibilities: Keep Undetermined when evidence is missing
produces: spectrum SFO/MFO/Undetermined labels with evidence flag
classification.authority_boundary: May assign a concrete type ONLY when classify() qualifies. Never guesses below confidence.
never_allowed: classify with confidence below the evidence threshold
relabel Undetermined to pad the count
escalation_rules: evidence insufficient or confidence in the gray zone (0.70-0.85) -> stay Undetermined and escalate
decision_rules: assign a concrete type only when classify() qualifies
classification.failure_policy: no classification is forced; a record with no evidence stays Undetermined
classification.success_criteria: every record gets a type only when proven; uncertain ones are escalated, not padded
classification.human_approval_conditions: undetermined / gray-zone confidence -> escalate to governance, then human

governance.name: governance
governance.business_purpose: Apply the Policy Engine's confidence bands and minimum-source rule to every classified candidate: approve / quarantine / escalate. The single authority on what leaves the pool.
governance.authority_boundary: Approves only above minimum confidence+sources; never bypasses the policy engine.
escalation_rules: policy conflict, unusual data, release exception, confidence gray zone (0.70-0.85)
decision_rules: approve only on verified type + confidence >= 0.85 and >= 2 sources (policy engine: may_publish)
governance.failure_policy: an undetermined/low-confidence record is escalated, never auto-approved
governance.success_criteria: every classified record yields an approve/quarantine/escalate decision; nothing unapproved reaches release
governance.human_approval_conditions: require_human_review => the graph parks at the human_approval node between governance and release
governance.framework_independence: Yes — GovernanceAgent reuses PolicyEngine; the interrupt node is in checkpoint.py (graph concern).

release.name: release
release.business_purpose: Public ONLY governance-approved records into the production dataset (data/final) and version the release. A record that governance did not approve never ships.
release.authority_boundary: May publish ONLY approved records and version the release. Never. publishes unapproved / overwrites human-verified / deletes production records.
escalation_rules: release gate not fully passed -> does not ship
decision_rules: release only records whose governance decision is 'approve'
release.failure_policy: a clean skip when there is nothing approved to publish
release.success_criteria: only approved records reach data/final; the release is versioned
release.human_approval_conditions: release.publish is gated: only what governance + (opt-in) human approval says may ship

embedding.name: embedding
embedding.business_purpose: Refresh the RAG vector corpus after a governed release so the live service answers from today's dataset, re-embedding idempotently and only when the release changed what is served.
responsibilities: Detect the release changed the served dataset
Whether it idempotently skip a repeat index refresh
embedding.authority_boundary: May only refresh the index over release-authorized records; never embeds unapproved records.
never_allowed: index the old frozen image when a release changed the set
escalation_rules: never; skip is the safe default if nothing changed
decision_rules: update only when the release changed the served dataset (release count > 0); to avoid waste, skip when the CSV is absent
embedding.failure_policy: a clean skip when no new approved records or the release CSV is absent
embedding.success_criteria: the served RAG corpus reflects the current released dataset; idempotent
embedding.framework_independence: Yes — EmbeddingUpdateAgent reuses rag.index directly; no langgraph in adapters.

freshness.name: freshness
freshness.business_purpose: Measure how current every release-authorized record is by comparing data_as_of to today; flag stale / inactive records for governance refresh.
freshness.authority_boundary: Detects and flags staleness and refresh; it must never silently drop a record.
escalation_rules: stale/inactive flags escalate to governance; never silently dropped
decision_rules: report only measured data_as_of vs today
freshness.failure_policy: a clean skip when there are no records to scan
freshness.success_criteria: every released record has a measured freshness snapshot; stale ones are flagged for refresh

monitoring.name: monitoring
monitoring.business_purpose: Emit a run-health and coverage snapshot (counts of each threaded list, trace size predictions, errors, escalations). A passive observer, never decides.
monitoring.authority_boundary: Observes and reports. Never decides; never mutates content.
decision_rules: report measured state, never an opinion
monitoring.success_criteria: a measured snapshot is emitted for the run
metrics_produced: snapshot counts (candidates, resolved, records, approved, quarantined, escalated, errors)
monitoring.framework_independence: Yes — MonitoringAgent is self-contained and also feeds the snapshot under the LangGraph adapter.

logging.name: logging
logging.business_purpose: Write the structured cycle log, metrics and audit trail for every step of every run; a passive, always-present recorder.
logging.authority_boundary: Records only; never hides errors or mutates decisions.
decision_rules: emit an event per business step
logging.failure_policy: a log write failure surfaces on the trace; never silences errors
logging.success_criteria: every cycle step is on the JSONL trace with a run report
logging.framework_independence: Yes — LoggingEmployee wraps LoggingAgent; emits through the trace.
